The '''Alkenak system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Alkenak fields]] were located in the system.<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alkenak system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
